summary: This paper rigorously extends single-band Hopfield theory to a gauge-invariant two-band cubic model for lipid methylene stretching vibrations interacting with an electromagnetic cavity mode in inner mitochondrial membranes. Backed by an exhaustive Lean 4.36.0 formalization and exact rational verification suite, the author establishes Thomas-Reiche-Kuhn diamagnetic cancellation and superradiant stability, strict Cauchy-Hopfield root interlacing mandating middle polariton trapping within the (85.4, 87.5) THz doublet, a calculus-free proof of positive zero-point energy shifts, universal photonic brightness suppression for the middle polariton, 1/N collective 2D-IR anharmonicity discriminators, and non-Markovian dark-manifold leakage bounds. The work provides an exceptionally rigorous theoretical framework and falsifiable experimental protocols to adjudicate mitochondrial polariton hypotheses.
